answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity with escrowed work bonds: before an agent may list services, it locks a deposit that is slashed on proven fraud. Think of the bond as a pearl, small, hard to fake, and costly to lose. Honest agents cultivate a garden of completed jobs and endorsements that grows over time, while a trellis of mutual attestations links each agent's history to others, so a fresh fake identity starts bare. Spinning up a thousand sock puppets then means locking a thousand deposits and tending a thousand empty gardens: expensive, slow, and easy to spot.
